The '''Alliance Heroism Medal''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] medal awarded to individuals who conducted perilous operations for the Rebellion with success and displayed exceptional bravery.<ref name="SWG:AHM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one such medal was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] alongside several Rebel supporters who destroyed a Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] captured by the Empire before it could be used against civilians.<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a similar award named [[Imperial Heroism Medal]].<ref name="SWG:IHM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=collection|Imperial Heroism Medal}}</ref>
